task.instruction: Find a Python repository on GitHub that has been updated in the past 2 days and has at least 500 stars.

final_answer:
I ran a GitHub repository search with the filters `language:Python stars:>=500 pushed:>2026-10-30` (i.e. pushed within the last 2 days of today, Nov 1 2026), sorted by most recently updated. It returns 1.9k matching repositories; here are the ones on the first page:

**Top pick — `langgenius/dify`** (https://github.com/langgenius/dify)
- Language: Python · Stars: ~160,155
- Topics: python, agent, workflow, automation, ai
- Pushed within the last 2 days, per the filter
- A widely used open-source LLM app development platform (agentic workflows, RAG, model-agnostic).

Other qualifying repos from the same result set, if you want something smaller or more specialised:

| Repository | Stars | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `seedds/nxnative` | ~10,823 | Python, recently pushed |

judge.rationale: GitHub search/page shows `langgenius/dify` is Python, ~160k stars, and updated seconds ago under query `language:Python stars:>=500 pushed:>2026-10-30`.
